verdict.rationale: Claude Design is itself an AI agent/assistant product (built on Claude) rather than a platform whose ecosystem would ship an official MCP server for others to connect to. The one MCP-related mention (comm-7) describes Claude Design connecting *into* PenPot via MCP — a client-side usage — not Claude Design exposing its own MCP server, so this falls under the agent-role 'na' exception rather than the applicable-axis case.
